angles.name: Cause and effect
angles.text: Asli cause aur effect ko step-by-step samjho.

angles.name: Myth check
angles.text: Common guess aur verified explanation ko compare karo.

angles.name: Daily-life connection
angles.text: Is fact ko roz ke experience se connect karo.

angles.name: Hidden mechanism
angles.text: Andar ka mechanism simple language mein kholo.

angles.name: Unexpected comparison
angles.text: Isko ek contrasting everyday example se samjhao.

angles.name: What changes it
angles.text: Kaunse conditions is effect ko strong ya weak karti hain, sirf supported details ke saath.

angles.name: Notice it yourself
angles.text: Viewer ko safe everyday observation se concept notice karwao.

angles.name: How we learned it
angles.text: Sirf source-backed history mention karo; warna mechanism par raho.

angles.name: Scale and size
angles.text: Numbers tabhi do jab source exact figure support kare.

angles.name: Step-by-step sequence
angles.text: Process ko correct sequence mein break karo.

angles.name: Cause versus trigger
angles.text: Underlying cause aur immediate trigger alag samjhao.

angles.name: Material matters
angles.text: Material ke properties ka role explain karo.

angles.name: Environment matters
angles.text: Temperature, pressure, light ya surroundings ka documented role samjhao.

angles.name: Human connection
angles.text: Human experience se connect karo without medical advice.

angles.name: Animal adaptation
angles.text: Adaptation ko survival context ke saath explain karo.

angles.name: Space perspective
angles.text: Earth vs space contrast only when source supports it.

angles.name: Sound perspective
angles.text: Sound wave ya hearing mechanism ko simple banao.

angles.name: Light perspective
angles.text: Wavelength, reflection, scattering ya refraction mein jo relevant ho wahi use karo.

angles.name: Energy perspective
angles.text: Energy transfer/conversion ka accurate path explain karo.

angles.name: Time perspective
angles.text: Time sequence ya long-term process ko explain karo.

angles.name: Structure perspective
angles.text: Shape/structure ka effect explain karo.

angles.name: Signal perspective
angles.text: Chemical, electrical, optical ya sensory signal ka role samjhao.

angles.name: Whole-system perspective
angles.text: Individual part ke bajay whole system ka role dikhao.

angles.name: Why intuition fails
angles.text: Intuition kahan incomplete hai aur evidence kya kehta hai.

angles.name: Unexpected connection
angles.text: Ek source-backed bonus link add karo, unrelated fact mat jodo.

analogy_frames.text: Science ko ghar ki language mein: {analogy}

humour_frames.text: Isko yaad rakhne ka funny tareeka: {joke}

Ab is fact ka meme version: {joke}

formula: 64 fact seeds x 40 hooks x 25 editorial angles x 40 analogy frames x 40 humour frames = 102,400,000 candidate prompt compositions. Semantic de-duplication blocks a used fact-angle pair even if the wording frames differ.
